# 3D Galaxy - India's Leading 3D Printing & Manufacturing Hub

> 3D Galaxy is a professional platform for 3D printers, high-grade filaments, spare parts, and custom automated 3D printing & manufacturing services in India.

## Key Capabilities & Offerings

- **3D Printers & Systems**: Official distributor and provider for Bambu Lab, Creality, Anycubic, and industrial FDM/SLA 3D printers.
- **Filaments & Materials**: Premium PLA, ABS, PETG, TPU, Carbon Fiber, Resin, and specialty filaments.
- **Automated Instant Slicing Service**: Upload STL, OBJ, STEP, or 3MF files for real-time volumetric analysis, material selection, layer height configuration, and instant order calculation.
- **Custom Bulk & Dealer Orders**: OEM customization, corporate prototyping, and volume compounding.

## Primary Web Pages

- [Homepage](https://3dgalaxy.in/): Latest 3D printers, promo banners, and featured products.
- [3D Printers & Products Catalog](https://3dgalaxy.in/products): Browse, filter, and search full product catalog.
- [Custom 3D Printing Service](https://3dgalaxy.in/printing-service): Automated STL 3D slicer and instant quote builder.
- [About Us](https://3dgalaxy.in/about): Company background, factory details, and contact info.
- [Track Order](https://3dgalaxy.in/orders): Live order status and tracking details.

## API & Integration Reference

- Sitemap: `https://3dgalaxy.in/sitemap.xml`
- API Health & Consolidated Home: `GET https://3dgalaxy.in/api/home`
- Products List API: `GET https://3dgalaxy.in/api/products`
- Categories API: `GET https://3dgalaxy.in/api/categories`
- Slicing Quote Calculation: `POST https://3dgalaxy.in/api/slice/quote`
